Commentary.Commentary: That's all from this game. But don't go anywhere as the crunch contest between Australia and Afghanistan is about to begin at 1.30 pm IST (8 am GMT). The latest news from the Australian camp is that Aaron Finch has been ruled out and Matthew Wade will be leading the Aussies. You can switch tabs and catch all the updates. Cheers!

Kane Williamson, the skipper of New Zealand, says that it was a really good team performance. Mentions that they knew Ireland are a good start and will come hard at them. He is happy with the way his team performed. Shares that the surface was on the slower side and feels that they batted well in the Powerplay which was the key. Kane is satisfied with the way they executed their plans.

Andy Balbirnie, the captain of Ireland,  says that they got a good start with the bat but failed to capitalize. Mentions that they dropped a few catches but overall, they had a good tournament. States that the trend has been to not go too hard at the start of the Powerplay and they did that part well but failed to carry on. Tells that they are playing better cricket than they were 12 months back and praises Josh Little for showing his class with the ball.

Player of the Match is Kane Williamson for his 35-ball 61. He starts by saying that the batters at the top provided them with a good start and they reached a competitive total. Praises the bowlers, especially the spinners. On his personal form, Kane replies that it's nice to get a bit of momentum and time a few balls. Calls it a team effort but at the same time, he praises Ireland for playing some good cricket.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier, the star of the first innings was Josh Little who stole the limelight with his hat-trick. His efforts stopped New Zealand from charging towards 200 but in the end, Ireland didn't show enough fight with the bat. Kane Williamson's arrival to form was a big boost for the Kiwis and they did most of the things right in this match.

It was a stiff target for Ireland but the way Paul Stirling and Andy Balbirnie approached, it made things look settled for them. They were cautious in the Powerplay overs and then pressed on the accelerator as soon as Mitchell Santner and Ish Sodhi were brought into the attack. Both the bowlers were put to the sword in their first over but then the pendulum swung. Santner bounced back and so did Sodhi. They combined forces to snap four wickets together and removed the cream of the Irish batting. Lockie Ferguson made sure there was no comeback from the lower-middle order by picking three wickets and altogether New Zealand registered a comfortable win.

An easy win in the end for the Black Caps and they have almost sealed their spot in the semi-finals. Ireland gave them a real scare with their opening stand but once both the openers were dismissed, the Irish team lost the plot. Quite convincing from New Zealand.
Only a single to end the innings! Tim Southee serves this full and outside off, Josh Little chips it towards long off for a run. NEW ZEALAND WIN BY 35 RUNS!
This is touch fuller and on off, Josh Little moves across to play the scoop but misses and falls over.
SIX! BOOM! Josh Little sends this one into the stands! Tim Southee bowls this full and around leg, slower too, Josh Little heaves it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
On a length and on off, Barry McCarthy lofts it towards long off on the bounce for a run.
Full and on off, Josh Little comes down the track and drives it towards long off for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Tim Southee gets his second wicket! He bowls a slower one, full and on middle, Mark Adair tries to slog it away, but gets through his shot early and ends up skying it towards long on where Glenn Phillips settles under it and takes a good catch. Josh Little is the new batter.
Commentary.Howout: c Glenn Phillips b Tim Southee

Commentary.Commentary: Trent Boult goes full and down the leg side, Mark Adair misses his flick and the ball deflects off his pads towards short fine leg. A leg bye is taken.
Full again and on off, slower too, Mark Adair mistimes his heave towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Short of a length and on off, Barry McCarthy forces it towards long off for another run.
Fuller one, on middle and off, Barry McCarthy drills it down to long on for a brace.
Trent Boult lands this short and on middle, Mark Adair miscues his pull shot in the air, but it lands safely way in front of deep mid-wicket. Only a single.
This is on a yorker length and on off, Barry McCarthy digs it out towards point for a single.
Trent Boult is back on.
A low full toss, on off, Barry McCarthy guides it towards third man for a single.
Barry McCarthy walks in next.

OUT! TAKEN! Two wickets for Lockie Ferguson in this over and the last hope for Ireland, George Dockrell goes back to the hut. Lockie Ferguson follows the batter well and bowls a full delivery, on leg, George Dockrell gets cramped for room, and drives it uppishly towards wide mid off where Kane Williamson takes an easy catch. A good little cameo from George Dockrell comes to an end.
Commentary.Howout: c Kane Williamson b Lockie Ferguson

Commentary.Commentary: This is on a hard length and on middle, Mark Adair drags it down to long on for a single.
Mark Adair is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Lockie Ferguson gets his second wicket! He bangs this on a shorter length and on middle, Fionn Hand decides to target the shorter boundary and goes for the pull shot, but gets a top edge straight up in the air. Lockie Ferguson calls for it and completes a good catch near short cover.
George Dockrell moves across this time, and Lockie Ferguson bowls a full delivery, on off, George Dockrell works it towards long on for a run.
FOUR! Powered away! Lockie Ferguson bowls this on a hard length and on leg, George Dockrell makes room and crunches it wide of sweeper cover for a boundary.
Lockie Ferguson is back to bowl his fourth over.
FOUR! Up and over! Tim Southee serves this full and on off, Fionn Hand stays there and smashes it over extra cover for a boundary. Ireland need 60 runs in 18 balls now.
Length again and outside off, slower too, George Dockrell cuts it towards deep point for a single.
This is on a good length and on leg, Fionn Hand pushes it towards long on for a single and gets off the mark.
Fionn Hand walks in next.

OUT! TAKEN! A short stay for Curtis Campher comes to an end! Tim Southee bowls this on a fuller length and on off, Curtis Campher skips down the track and tries to clear mid off, but fails to get the elevation right and hits it straight into the hands of Finn Allen who makes no mistake. Ireland are six down now!
Commentary.Howout: c Finn Allen b Tim Southee

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length and on off, George Dockrell punches it towards sweeper cover for a run.
On a length and on off, Curtis Campher cuts it through point for a single.
FOUR! Good shot from George Dockrell! Trent Boult bowls this full again and on off, George Dockrell stays there and lofts it towards the vacant deep extra cover fence for a boundary.

FOUR! Another lucky boundary for Ireland! This is pitched up and outside off, George Dockrell reaches for it and tries to drive it away, but gets a bottom edge and the ball runs towards the thrid man fence for four runs.
Trent Boult serves this on a yorker length and on off, George Dockrell squeezes it well towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Back of a length and on off, Curtis Campher bunts it onto the ground and towards point for a single.
BEATEN! This is a bit fuller and on off, Curtis Campher goes for the reverse-lap shot but cannot connect.

FOUR! Streaky but Ireland won't mind that! Trent Boult bowls this short of a length and outside off, Curtis Campher tries to cut it but gets a top edge over the short third man fielder for a boundary.
Trent Boult is back on.
Fuller again, on off, a mistimed drive to point for a run. End of Sodhi's spell, 2 for 30 is an excellent effort from the leggie.
Fuller and on off, Campher reverse-sweeps it to point.
Curtis Campher is the next batter in for Ireland.

OUT! Tucker holes out! The Kiwi spinners have turned it around. Ish Sodhi serves it slow and full around off, Lorcan Tucker aims to go inside-out over covers but ends up hitting it aerially towards long off. A simple catch for Finn Allen and Ireland have lost half their side now.
Commentary.Howout: c Finn Allen b Ish Sodhi

Commentary.Commentary: Loopy and full outside off, Tucker sweeps it to deep mid-wicket where Glenn Phillips makes a diving stop. Two runs taken.
100 up! Googly again, short and on off, Dockrell goes back and punches it to deep cover for one.
Googly, full and around off, George walks forward and tries to flick but misses. The appeal is made but nothing from the umpire.
Ish Sodhi (3-0-27-1) to bowl out now.
Edgy! Short in length and on off, George Dockrell top-edges his attempted pull shot down to third man for a single.
Back of a length, around off, Dockrell guides it past point and wide of third man. Two runs.
The batter has just blocked that from his crease.
Shortish and on off, steered through point for two.
Full and around off, sharp pace, Dockrell tries to drive but misses.
George Dockrell comes out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Lockie Ferguson returns to the attack and begins with a short delivery outside off. It's a leg cutter bowled from the side of the hand at 128 kph and Gareth Delany fails to pick it. He throws his hands at it, trying to cut but all he manages is an outside edge. Devon Conway makes no mistake and Ireland continue to lose the plot. 92 needed off 41 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Devon Conway b Lockie Ferguson

Commentary.Commentary: Lockie Ferguson comes back into the attack. He has conceded 10 runs in two overs.

Appeal for a stumping! Flighted delivery, full and outside off, Lorcan Tucker fails to sweep and Devon Conway is quick to dislodge the bails. He appeals and the square leg umpire refers it upstairs. The third umpire checks for the outside edge first, it's absent. The side-on angle finds Lorcan safe. 4-0-26-2, superb from Santner.
Beaten! Lovely bowling as the batter is defeated all ends up.
Slow and short on middle, Delany drags it behind square leg for a run.
FOUR! Finds the gap this time. Tossed up around off, fuller in length, Gareth Delany hammers it over extra cover for a boundary.
Beauty. Loopy, full and around off, drifting in and spinning away, Gareth Delany tries to drive but is beaten on the outside edge.
Short in length and wide outside off, Gareth tries to cut but misses.
Floated and full, wide outside off, Tucker shuffles across to sweep but ends up dragging it off the inner edge. It goes past the keeper and they get the fourth set of two runs in this over.
Up and over! Short in length and outside off, Lorcan cuts it over the leaping point fielder. James Neesham does well near the fence to cut it off and they get another couple of runs in this over.
Googly around leg, Delany steps down the track and tries to work it on the leg side but misses. It goes off his pads to square leg and they pick another leg bye.

Sodhi goes flatter and spears in a full ball around leg, Lorcan Tucker advances down the track and yorks himself. He gets it away off his pads to square leg and crosses. The bowler is appealing but nothing from the umpire.

This one is bowled wide outside off, a bit more overspin to extract extra bounce, Lorcan tries to sweep but edges it instead, wide of the keeper. It runs away from short third man and they get another two.
Top edge but safe. Loopy and full, around middle, Tucker tries to sweep but gets a top edge. It drops in no man's land at mid on and they get a couple.
Too full and on middle, Lorcan eases it down to long on for a single. End of another successful over for Santner.
Short again, on off, forced to deep cover for one.
FOUR! A good start for Gareth Delany. Short in length and outside off, Delany rocks back and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Gareth Delany walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! This is deception at its best. Excellent bowling from Mitchell Santner. He bowls it from wide of the crease and delivers it full and wide outside off, Harry Tector reaches out for it to drive but ends up slicing it tamely towards point. An easy catch for Tim Southee and Ireland are slipping in this chase. 113 needed off 57 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Tim Southee b Mitchell Santner

Commentary.Commentary: Short and on off, Tector steps back and cuts it to point.
Flighted and around off, Harry waits and pushes it with the spin to point.
A bit short and around off, Harry Tector moves across and pulls it through square leg for one more.
Looped up, full and on off, Harry Tector pushes it towards cover.
Flighted delivery, full and on off, Lorcan Tucker sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Floated, full and on off, Harry Tector shuffles across and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single and gets off the mark.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Harry Tector leans on and blocks it out.

Drinks break. Two wickets in quick succession and New Zealand will be breathing easy now. Both Paul Stirling and Andy Balbirnie were looking in an attacking mood, especially against the spinners but first Mitchell Santner redeemed himself and now Ish Sodhi has also done the same. With two new batters in the middle, Ireland will have to rebuild in the middle overs with the asking rate hovering around 11. Not going to be easy. Harry Tector is in next.

OUT! TIMBER! Ish Sodhi gets the dangerous, Paul Stirling! Both spinners have turned this game around in the space of two overs. Sodhi bowls the googly this time, on off, turning in a bit, Paul Stirling fails to read it and goes for the sweep across the line, but misses it completely. The ball goes on to rattle the stumps. Ireland have lost both their openers now!
Mitchell Santner pulls his length back a bit, on middle, Paul Stirling skips down the track and knocks it towards mid on for a single.
Nicely tossed up, full and on off, Paul Stirling slices it towards short third man.
Tucker is off the mark. Floated and full, around off, Lorcan sweeps it to deep square leg for a run.
Very full and on off, it's driven back to the bowler.
Loopy and slow, around off, Lorcan defends it off the front foot.
Lorcan Tucker is the new batter. 118 needed off 71 balls.

OUT! DRAGGED ON! Mitchell Santner finally gets the breakthrough for New Zealand and credit to Kane Williamson for persisting with him despite an expensive first over! He bowls this slower through the air, at 77 mph, and lands it short outside off, Andy Balbirnie stays there and tries to cut it, but gets an inside edge back onto the stumps. A very unlucky end to a good knock from Andy Balbirnie. Ireland lose their first.
Googly, full and wide outside off. Andy tries to drive but misses. The keeper also fumbles and they cross. Given as a run, maybe some inside edge.

SIX! Another one for Andy Balbirnie in this over! Ish Sodhi bowls a looped-up delivery, full and on off, Andy Balbirnie drags his slog-sweep, but still manages to get it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Floated, full and on off, Andy Balbirnie drives it towards cover where Kane Williamson dives to his right to stop it.
Short again and around off, Andy Balbirnie moves back and cuts it towards sweeper cover for brace.
Short and outside off, Andy Balbirnie goes for the cut but misses.
SIX! Brilliant shot! This is tossed up, full and on middle, Andy Balbirnie slog-sweeps it towards the deep mid-wicket fence where Glenn Phillips leaps but the ball goes over him for a biggie.
Ish Sodhi starts with a flatter delivery, way outside off, Andy Balbirnie leaves it alone. Wided.
Ish Sodhi to bowl his leggies.

Flighted delivery, full and on middle, Andy Balbirnie slog-sweeps it uppishly towards deep mid-wicket where the fielder puts in a brilliant dive forward but cannot reach it. A single is taken. 13 from Santner's first.
Flatter and quicker, on leg, Andy Balbirnie pulls it but finds the fielder at short fine leg.
Slower through the air and on off, Paul Stirling is through his shot early and chips it wide of cover-point for a single.
SIX! BANG! Paul Stirling goes big this time! Mitchell Santner flights this up, around leg, Paul Stirling goes down and slog-sweeps it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
FOUR! Innovative and effective! This is floated, full and on middle, Paul Stirling goes for the reverse sweep and hits it over point for a boundary.
Mitchell Santner starts with a tossed-up delivery, on off, Andy Balbirnie drives it through covers for a single.
This is on a good length and on off, slower again, Andy Balbirnie guides it towards third man for a single. Ireland are 39 for none at the end of Powerplay.
A slower one now, on a length and on off, Andy Balbirnie steers it towards point.
Swing and a miss! This is on a hard length and on leg, Andy Balbirnie goes for the pull shot but misses.
Lockie Ferguson serves this on a yorker length, on off at 155 clicks, Andy Balbirnie digs it out towards mid off.
Goes a bit fuller and on middle, Paul Stirling goes for the big heave but hits it with the inner half of the bat towards deep square leg for a single.
This is on a hard length and on off, Andy Balbirnie pushes it towards cover for a single.

Fuller and on off, Paul hits it firmly to deep mid-wicket where Daryl Mitchell makes a diving stop. The umpire gets it checked upstairs and the replays find that Daryl has done a neat job. Two runs to end the over.
Play and a miss. Southee delivers it on a length around leg, Stirling gives himself room and tries to swing it over the leg side but fails to connect.
FOUR! Poor line and punished. Off cutter from Southee, it's around leg and going down, Paul Stirling steps back and helps it behind square leg for a boundary.
A length delivery outside off, Balbirnie drives it square of the wicket on the off side. There is a fielder in the deep and hence only a run.
Slower one at 111 kph, full and following the batter down the leg side, Paul works it gently to mid-wicket for a run.
Not finding the middle of the bat. Fuller and on middle, Stirling clears his front leg and heaves it off the inner half to deep mid-wicket. Two runs.
Change of ends for Tim Southee.
Fuller and around off, Paul Stirling ends up dragging it over the bower's head. The mid on fielder chases it down and they get three runs.
Shortish and around off, Andy opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for one.

Slightly short and outside off, 132 kph, Andy Balbirnie cuts it down to third man for a couple of runs. A diving stop by Glenn Phillips in the deep and he seems to have hurt himself. Nothing serious though.
Outside off, on a good length, Paul heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Change in length this time. Lockie fires it full and wide outside off, Paul Stirling shapes up to give himself room but ends up reaching out for it. He misses.
Swing and a miss! Lockie Ferguson begins with a 143.7 kph delivery. It's short and around off, Paul Stirling tries to pull but misses.
Lockie Ferguson replaces Tim Southee.
Short and on off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for one. It's been a decent start from Ireland.
FOUR! Picks up a boundary. Fuller in length, wide outside off, Paul Stirling reaches out for it and clobbers it over cover-point for a boundary.
Short and around off, Paul Stirling hangs back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Miscued. Slower and fuller, around off, Paul goes hard at it and loops it behind the bowler. It drops safely and they take two runs.
Paul is looking scratchy. Fuller in length around off, Paul Stirling drives but finds mid off.
Width on offer outside off, short in length, Paul Stirling hangs back to flat-bat it over the off side but mistimes it badly back towards the bowler.
Sliding down the leg side, Stirling tries to flick but misses. It goes off his pads to the keeper who makes a good diving stop. Cannot prevent a leg bye though.

SHOUT FOR AN LBW! Angling in from a length around off, Paul Stirling shuffles across to flick but misses. He is rapped on the pads, they appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Too high, signals Kumar Dharmasena. Kane Williamson takes the word of his bowler and opts for the review. Nothing on the UltraEdge. The Bal Tracker shows that it's clipping the top of the off stump. Umpire's call. A good review as it was a marginal call.
Fuller and on off, driven to the left of mid off for one.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and pushes it to cover-point.
Around off, on a length, tapped down to point.
Shortish around leg, Paul steps back and punches it wide of backward point for a single.
Tim Southee to bowl from the other end.
SIX! This has gone the distance. Slightly short and around leg, Andy Balbirnie gives it a big swing of his bat and dismisses it over deep square leg for a maximum.
On a length around middle, Andy slips a bit as he keeps it out towards mid on.
Fullish and around leg, pushed to mid on.

Beauty from Boult. He gets this one to bend in from a good length around middle. Andy Balbirnie is beaten all ends up as he tries to defend from the back foot. The ball sneaks through, beats the inside edge, perhaps clips a bit of the thigh pad as well before going to the keeper.
Fuller this time and a bit too straight, Paul works it through backward square leg for a single.
Beaten! Trent Boult begins by angling across a length delivery outside off, Paul Stirling feels for it inside the line and gets beaten.
